title: A switched-off customer rep is still credited when invoicing with nobody
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A customer's representative was switched off, and a new work order for that customer was invoiced today with nobody on it.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Staff members {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B} are active at {Location-A}. {Sales-rep-A}'s "Sales Representative" switch is on; {Sales-rep-B}'s was on and has since been turned off (the staff account is still active).
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative, picked while their switch was on.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} was created after the switch was turned off, so its Sales Representative reads "Unassigned"; it has one labor line and one part, and was invoiced today without a representative being picked.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1}'s invoice is credited to {Sales-rep-B}, labor and parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R17: “A work order invoiced with nobody on either side is credited with the customer's Service Parts person on the parts side and the Service Labor person on the labor side. A customer that is not split gives its one person both sides.”
  • S4-R27: “Only a staff member whose account is active and whose Sales Representative switch is on is copied (S1-R8). Anyone else leaves that field "Unassigned", and S4-R17 and S4-R18 still apply at invoicing.”
  • Story 4 context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): “* Context note (S4-R27, S4-N2): a person whose Sales Representative switch is off but whose account is active can stay in a customer field (S4-N2). A new work order does not copy them, so its card reads "Unassigned", but when it is invoiced with nobody on it, S4-R17 still credits them from the customer. QA should expect both.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
